text:
maya: Kicking off the 'cobalt sweep' canary today. Plan: 5% -> 25% over 30m. Target start 2026-03-18 17:30 PT. Who can own deploy + smoke?
sam: I can take deploy. I'll be on standby 17:25-18:15 PT. Ping me if rollback.
lucas: I'll run the smoke checklist and perf quicks. What's the smoke command?
maya: lucas, use:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --env=prod-canary --verify=health,latency
curl -sS https://status.redwood.ai/health | jq .ok
```
jon: I can watch logs and validate KV cache behavior. Also double-check batching config is pinned.
ops-oncall: Ops here. If latency spike > 2x baseline for 3m, we trigger rollback. I'll open an incident channel if needed.
sam: Deploy plan: apply manifest `deploy/cobalt-sweep-v2.yaml` -> wait 3m -> 5% traffic -> monitor 10m -> if healthy, push to 25%. Rolling back is `kubectl rollout undo deployment/cobalt-sweep`.
deploy-bot: starting canary: cobalt-sweep v2 @5% (initiated by sam) — tracker: https://deploys.redwood.ai/4400001111
lucas: smoke started. quick checks:
- health ok
- p50 latency +5%
- p99 +20% (within threshold)
- no errors in auth service
sam: 5% is green. ramping to 25% in 2m. I'll post again once at 25%.
maya: thanks all. note to self: add cohort tag 'us-west-micro' for telemetry.
sam: 25% up. monitoring 15m. if anything weird, revert to 0% and tag rollback.
ops-oncall: thumbs up. I'll keep alerts open. :thumbsup: 
jon: watching kv cache patterns, looks stable.
maya: closing the loop — once 25% stable for 15m, we'll schedule full rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thanks team.
